portals.name: MP Bhulekh

portals.name: Morena GIS
portals.operator: District Administration Morena / NIC, Government of India
portals.observation: Official District Morena describes a district GIS containing land use and public-infrastructure layers and links the portal. The direct bounded request timed out; no cadastral layer, schema, CRS, native parcel identity or geometry response was verified.

requests.assessment: Official English District Morena page states that village spatial and non-spatial land-record data is publicly available through MP Bhulekh and identifies Tahsil Office Morena at the Collectorate. This establishes local administrative custody/context, not a vector API.
Official Hindi District Morena page gives the same public MP Bhulekh route and names Tahsil Morena; no parcel geometry was returned.
Official Morena GIS page describes district GIS layers and links the portal at morenagis.mp.gov.in; page content did not expose a parcel API.
Direct anonymous request timed out after 20 seconds from this environment. This is not evidence of citywide absence or map extent miss; no retry with credentials or TLS bypass was made.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official District Morena land-record and GIS routes; no parcel-level coverage claim.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: District-level public land-record route and district GIS portal were identified. Anonymous parcel schema, CRS, native identity and geometry at the exact WUP point were not verified.

technicalBlocker: The official MP Bhulekh and Morena GIS portal endpoints timed out during bounded anonymous GETs, so current JavaScript/configuration, public service URLs, schema/CRS, safe native parcel identity and geometry could not be inspected. Official district pages provide administrative context but do not themselves provide parcel polygons.
remainingUncertainty: A public parcel-vector or map-query route may exist behind the current MP Bhulekh/Morena GIS viewer. Exact WUP-point inclusion, local village/tehsil identity, parcel coverage and citywide completeness remain unverified.
nextStep: On a later attempt, inspect the public viewer configuration with ordinary anonymous requests and, if available, issue a bounded geometry-only exact-point or small-extent query requesting only a stable parcel identifier and polygon geometry.
sourceQuality: Official District Morena / Government of Madhya Pradesh pages and linked government portals; no parcel geometry source was qualified.
